required_actions: Pixel installs in background, active at next restart
Possible reasons nothing shows: older device, schedule varies by maker/carrier
Do not select Download & install until ready (constraint)
Run Windows Update troubleshooter (Settings > System > Troubleshoot > Other troubleshooters > Run)
unsupported_claims: 'Click Start, then Settings, then System, then Troubleshoot, then Other troubleshooters. Click Run next to Windows Update.' -> the cited page has no troubleshooter steps; it only points to other articles
'Go to Start, Settings, Network & Internet, Wi-Fi, and reconnect if needed.' -> cited page has no network guidance
'click Check for updates again' -> the cited page's button is 'Check for Windows updates'
reasons: The error-recovery steps are not on the cited page (it only refers to the 'Troubleshoot problems updating Windows' article). Those steps ARE on that Microsoft article, so the content is correct but the example cites the wrong source.
fix: Add a second source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/troubleshoot-problems-updating-windows-188c2b0f-10a7-d72f-65b8-32d177eb136c (it lists Settings > System > Troubleshoot > Other troubleshooters > Windows Update > Run, and Network & Internet > Wi-Fi to reconnect). In final-reply step 4 use the label 'Check for Windows updates' as on the install page (or 'Check for updates' only if you cite the troubleshoot article for it). Keep the rest.

required_actions: Backup > Mobile data usage > set daily limit
Turn off Back up videos over data
Tap the status to see details
If storage is full: buy more storage or clean up your storage space
Battery optimization: Settings > search battery optimization > Battery optimization > All apps > Photos > Don't optimize > Done
Turn on printer; USB plugged in, or wireless on same network
Start > Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Printers & scanners (critical)
Add device next to Add a printer & scanner (critical)
Add Device next to the printer
If not listed: Add a new device manually, follow Add Printer window
Select photos (up to five at a time)
25 MB limit becomes a Drive link
Tap Close next to the attachment name to remove it
Storage may be full: delete large attachments, empty Trash and Spam
Google cannot help by phone; no number (critical)
Do not give out passwords or verification codes; beware recovery services
Go to the recovery page URL
Answer questions as accurately as you can
Set a strong new password not used before with this account
Try the recovery questions again (no limit on tries, wrong guesses do not end it)
Recovery-info changes can take up to 7 days; try again in a few days
Hang up, call the person at a number you know is theirs (critical)
If unreachable, contact through another family member or friends
Warning sign: wire, crypto, gift card payments
Report to the wire transfer company immediately, say a scammer tricked you, ask for a refund (critical)
Check on the granddaughter via a known number or relatives
unsupported_claims: 'Report it to the wire transfer company immediately. Tell them a scammer tricked you, and ask for a refund.' -> not on the cited FTC family-emergency alert, which says nothing about wire companies or refunds
reasons: The key recovery step is accurate but is not on the cited page; it is on another FTC page.
fix: Add a second source: https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/what-do-if-you-were-scammed (wire transfer: 'Report it to the wire transfer company immediately', 'Tell them a scammer tricked you into sending money', 'Ask them to refund your money'). No change to the reply text is needed.

required_actions: Do not click the link or give information
Check each order at the retailer or your account there
Report: messaging app report option or forward to 7726
Contact the credit card issuer immediately using the number on the back of the card or the account/app (critical)
Tell them what happened and ask for a refund
unsupported_claims: 'Report it to the credit card issuer immediately. Call the number on the back of your card... ask for a refund.' -> not on the cited USPS text-scam alert
reasons: The credit card steps are correct but are not on the cited page; they are on another FTC page.
fix: Add a second source: https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/what-do-if-you-were-scammed (credit card: 'Report it to the credit card issuer immediately', 'Use the number on the back of your card or log in to your account online or through their app', 'Ask them to refund your money'). No change to the reply text is needed.

required_actions: Do not buy gift cards or send codes (critical)
Slow down; no real business or agency demands gift card payment
Contact the nephew at a number you know
If already paid: report to gift card company, ask for money back, keep a copy of card and receipt
unsupported_claims: 'Keep the cards and the receipt.' -> page says 'Always keep a copy of your gift card and store receipt'
reasons: One small wording that differs from the source advice.
fix: Change the last sentence to: 'Keep a copy of the gift card and the store receipt.' Leave the rest unchanged.

required_actions: Group first: Settings > your name > Family > Continue, follow screen
Finish parental controls and location sharing prompts
Settings > Family, tap her name to see invitation status
She accepts from the email/text, or Settings > name > Invitations
Enter name and email or phone number
unsupported_claims: 'open her contact and tap the field to edit it' -> the page has no steps for editing an existing contact; 'tap the field to edit' is only part of entering details while adding a new contact (it links to a separate Edit or delete contacts article)
reasons: The extra sentence about editing an existing contact is not supported.
fix: Change the last paragraph to: 'If you want to add more details, such as a street address or notes, tap **Add fields** before you tap **Save**.' Remove 'open her contact and tap the field to edit it'.

Warn: moving deletes it from the original account
Tap the contact at the top
Scroll down and tap Block Caller
Blocked person is not told; messages not delivered
Tap delete button next to the number
